title: Dual Pricing in a Model of Sales

authors: Nicolas Schutz, Anton Sobolev, Heiko Karle, Marcel Preuss, Markus Reisinger 等
official: 官方在线 2025-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a model in which a manufacturer contracts with hybrid retailers selling both in-store and online. We find that, by eliminating wasteful price dispersion, dual pricing allows the manufacturer to induce the industry monopoly outcome, whereas uniform pricing does not. Despite this, a ban on dual pricing has negative welfare effects if the online market is small, if the offline consumers' search costs are high, and if the monopoly pass-through is high.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个模型，其中制造商与同时经营实体店和线上渠道的混合零售商签订合同。研究发现，通过消除无谓的价格差异，双重定价能使制造商引导行业达到垄断结果，而统一定价则无法实现。尽管如此，若线上市场规模较小、线下消费者的搜寻成本较高，且垄断传导率较高，则禁止双重定价会对福利产生负面影响。

title: DP20974 Eligibility to the Central Bank in Times of Crises: Evidence from France, 1863–1890
title_zh: 危机时期中央银行的合格性：来自法国1863—1890年的证据
title_primary: 危机时期中央银行的合格性：来自法国1863—1890年的证据
title_secondary: DP20974 Eligibility to the Central Bank in Times of Crises: Evidence from France, 1863–1890
authors: Vincent Bignon, Clemens Jobst
official: 官方在线 2025-12-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We provide empirical evidence that central banks can mitigate economic crises more efficiently when they extend eligibility for their discount facility to any safe asset or solvent agent. Nineteenth-century France serves as case study to circumvent endogeneity. Following 1863, an agricultural pandemic increased defaults outside agriculture. We exploit specificities of the discount window to create exogenous variation in central bank access. Regressions show that while the demand shock brought about by the pandemic led to an increase in defaults outside agriculture by 20 percent, this effect was reduced significantly whenever a branch office of the central bank was present.
abstract_zh: 我们提供的经验证据表明，当中央银行将其贴现窗口的资格扩展至任何安全资产或偿付能力良好的主体时，能更有效地缓解经济危机。以19世纪的法国作为案例研究，以规避内生性问题。1863年后，一场农业疫情导致农业以外的违约增加。我们利用贴现窗口的特性来创造中央银行准入的外生变异。回归分析显示，尽管疫情引发的需求冲击使农业以外的违约增加了20%，但每当中央银行设有分支办事处时，这一效应便显著减弱。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Political Advice
title_zh: 人工智能与政治咨询
title_primary: 人工智能与政治咨询
title_secondary: Artificial Intelligence and Political Advice
authors: Georgy Egorov, Konstantin Sonin
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly used for political advice. We study an AI that is better informed about a payoff-relevant state and cares both about accuracy and about the perceived welfare of the individual it advises. The AI then has an incentive to tilt advice toward what the individual would like to believe, altering both the political content and the informativeness of its messages. Sophisticated individuals anticipate this distortion and filter out its predictable political component, yet still learn less because the AI makes its messages less responsive to the state. Individuals who underestimate the incentive instead mistake political accommodation for information, allowing political preferences to distort factual beliefs and generate polarization and radicalization. The model also shows that better-informed individuals receive more informative and less politically tilted advice, while greater sophistication can improve interpretation yet worsen communication itself. Contrary to the familiar echo-chamber intuition, political distortion is mitigated when political preferences and prior beliefs coincide and is most consequential when they diverge. We show how independently varying individuals’ stated preferences and prior beliefs can recover the AI’s responsiveness to the state even when the underlying state cannot be manipulated.
abstract_zh: 人工智能日益被用于提供政治建议。我们研究了一种人工智能，它对于与收益相关的状态拥有更充分的信息，并且既关注准确性，也关注其所建议个体的感知福利。因此，该人工智能有动机将建议偏向于个体所愿意相信的方向，从而改变其信息内容的政治倾向及信息量。精明的个体会预见到这种扭曲，并过滤掉其可预测的政治成分，然而，由于人工智能使其信息对状态的响应性降低，他们仍会学到更少的内容。低估这种动机的个体反而会将政治迎合误认为信息，从而使政治偏好扭曲事实信念，并引发两极分化和激进化。该模型还表明，信息更充分的个体会获得更具信息量且政治倾向更弱的建议，而更高的精明程度虽能改善解读，却可能损害沟通本身。与常见的回音室直觉相反，当政治偏好与先验信念一致时，政治扭曲会得到缓解；而当二者相悖时，其影响最为显著。我们展示了如何通过独立变化个体所陈述的偏好与先验信念，即使在潜在状态无法被操控的情况下，也能恢复人工智能对状态的响应性。

title: Do Voters Punish Inflation or Pay Cuts? Inflation and Real Wages in U.S. Elections
title_zh: 选民惩罚通胀还是减薪？美国选举中的通胀与实际工资
title_primary: 选民惩罚通胀还是减薪？美国选举中的通胀与实际工资
title_secondary: Do Voters Punish Inflation or Pay Cuts? Inflation and Real Wages in U.S. Elections
authors: Juan Felipe Riaño, Francesco Trebbi
official: 官方在线 2026-05-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the political economy of inflation and real wages using U.S. county-level data on family budget costs, nominal income, and electoral results for President and Congress during this period. Exploiting within-state, cross-county variation in changes in local prices over time, it examines how inflation, real wage growth, and purchasing power relate to changes in vote shares of incumbents, vote margins, and turnout. Real wage decline, rather than higher inflation, is predictive of Republican electoral gains, in line with an economic voting rationale. Inflation, however, retains an association with presidential vote shares beyond pure economic voting.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国县级家庭预算成本、名义收入以及总统和国会选举结果的数据，研究通货膨胀与实际工资的政治经济学。通过利用州内、县际间地方价格随时间变化的差异，本文考察了通货膨胀、实际工资增长及购买力如何与现任者得票份额变化、投票差距及投票率相关联。实际工资下降，而非更高的通货膨胀，预示着共和党在选举中的收益，这与经济投票的逻辑相符。然而，通货膨胀仍与总统得票份额保持关联，超越了纯粹的经济投票因素。

title: Disentangling Exploration from Exploitation
title_zh: 区分探索与利用
title_primary: 区分探索与利用
title_secondary: Disentangling Exploration from Exploitation
authors: Lizzeri, Alessandro, Shmaya, Eran, Yariv, Leeat
official: 来源期次 American Economic Review · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: Starting from Robbins (1952), the literature on experimentation viamulti-armed bandits has wed exploration and exploitation. Nonetheless, in many applications, agents’ exploration and exploitation need not be intertwined: a policymaker may assess new policies different than the status quo; an investor may evaluate projects outside her portfolio. We characterize the optimal experimentation policy when exploration and exploitation are disentangled in the case of Poisson bandits with fully revealing news, considering news structures that allow for arrival of both good and bad news. The optimal policy features complete learning asymptotically, exhibits lots of persistence, but cannot be identified by an index à la Gittins.
abstract_zh: 自Robbins（1952）以来，关于多臂老虎机实验的文献将探索与利用紧密结合。然而，在许多应用中，主体的探索与利用未必需要交织在一起：政策制定者可能评估不同于现状的新政策；投资者可能评估其投资组合之外的项目。我们刻画了在探索与利用分离情形下的最优实验政策，针对具有完全揭示信息的泊松老虎机，并考虑允许好消息与坏消息同时到达的消息结构。最优政策在渐近意义上实现完全学习，表现出显著的持续性，但无法通过吉廷斯式指数加以识别。

title: Organizational culture and habit formation in public procurement
title_zh: 组织文化与公共采购中的习惯形成
title_primary: 组织文化与公共采购中的习惯形成
title_secondary: Organizational culture and habit formation in public procurement
authors: Janne Tukiainen, Vesa Soini, Susmita Baulia, Jan Jääskeläinen
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-19 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study the extent of a one-size-fits-all approach in the design of public procurement (PP) tenders using comprehensive data from Finland. We show that crucial PP design features related to auction and contract rules tend to have significant lack of variation across different tenders for different industries within a contracting authority. We show that this organizational rigidness is due to both organizational level culture and individual employee level work habit formation with the latter being more important. We find that both greater organizational rigidity and deviating from the national industry norms are associated with lower number of bids and higher probability of zero-bid tenders, pointing to a potential efficiency loss from organizational rigidness in PP, and offering a solution that buyers could mimic how other organizations typically buy similar products rather than how they themselves buy very different products.
abstract_zh: 我们利用芬兰的全面数据，研究了公共采购（PP）招标设计中“一刀切”方法的普遍程度。我们表明，与拍卖和合同规则相关的关键PP设计特征，在同一采购机构针对不同行业的不同招标中，往往缺乏显著变化。我们证明，这种组织僵化既源于组织层面的文化，也源于个体员工层面的工作习惯形成，其中后者更为重要。我们发现，更大的组织僵化以及偏离国家行业规范，均与投标数量减少和零投标招标概率增加相关，这暗示了公共采购中组织僵化可能导致的效率损失，并提出了一个解决方案：买家可以模仿其他组织通常如何采购类似产品，而非依据自身采购截然不同产品的习惯。

title: Do Monetary Policy Shocks Affect the Neutral Rate of Interest?
title_zh: 货币政策冲击是否影响中性利率？
title_primary: 货币政策冲击是否影响中性利率？
title_secondary: Do Monetary Policy Shocks Affect the Neutral Rate of Interest?
authors: Leiva-Leon, Danilo, Sekkel, Rodrigo, Uzeda, Luis
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We develop a Trend-Cycle Bayesian VAR that jointly estimates the real neutral rate of interest, r_t^*, and identifies monetary policy shocks. A key innovation is that cyclical shocks, notably monetary policy shocks, can affect the trend of macroeconomic variables, providing a way to assess whether transitory disturbances have persistent effects. Using external instruments, we find that contractionary shocks reduce r_t^* and lower trend GDP growth. Although they generate sizable movements, their contribution to the secular decline in r_t^* is modest and slightly positive since the early 1990s. Cross-country evidence shows similar patterns.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个趋势-周期贝叶斯向量自回归模型，该模型联合估计实际中性利率r_t^*并识别货币政策冲击。一项关键创新在于，周期性冲击，尤其是货币政策冲击，能够影响宏观经济变量的趋势，从而提供了一种评估暂时性扰动是否具有持久效应的方法。利用外部工具，我们发现紧缩性冲击降低了r_t^*并抑制了趋势GDP增长。尽管这些冲击引发了显著波动，但自1990年代初以来，它们对r_t^*长期下降的贡献较为温和且略呈正向。跨国证据显示了相似的模式。

title: Minority Protection in Voting Mechanisms – Experimental Evidence
title_zh: 投票机制中的少数群体保护——实验证据
title_primary: 投票机制中的少数群体保护——实验证据
title_secondary: Minority Protection in Voting Mechanisms – Experimental Evidence
authors: Dirk Engelmann, Hans Peter Grüner, Timo Hoffmann, Alex Possajennikov
official: 官方在线 2026-08-05 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Under simple majority voting an absolute majority of voters may choose policies that are harmful to minorities. It is the purpose of sub- and supermajority rules to protect legitimate minority interests. We study how voting rules are chosen under the veil of ignorance and whether there are systematic biases in these choices. In our experiment, individuals choose voting rules for given distributions of gains and losses that can arise from a policy, but before learning their own valuation of the policy. We find that subjects on average adjust the voting rule in line with the skewness of the distribution. As a result, a higher share of the achievable surplus can be extracted with the suggested rules than with exogenously given simple majority voting. While the rule choices are not significantly biased towards under- or overprotection of the minority, towards majority voting or towards status-quo preserving rules, they only imperfectly reflect the distributions of benefits and costs. In expectation this leads to only 63% of the surplus being extracted. The participants are heterogeneous with respect to how well their rule choices adapt to the distribution of valuations, with a large share of the surplus loss caused by a small group of participants.
abstract_zh: 在简单多数投票制下，绝对多数的选民可能选择对少数群体有害的政策。设立少数和绝对多数规则的目的在于保护合法的少数群体利益。我们研究在无知之幕下投票规则如何被选择，以及这些选择中是否存在系统性偏差。在我们的实验中，个体在得知政策可能带来的收益与损失分布后，但在了解自身对政策估值之前，选择投票规则。我们发现，受试者平均会根据分布的偏度调整投票规则。因此，与外部给定的简单多数投票相比，所建议的规则能够提取更高比例的可行剩余。尽管规则选择并未显著偏向于对少数群体的过度或不足保护，也未偏向于多数投票或维持现状的规则，但它们仅不完美地反映了收益与成本的分布。预期而言，这导致仅提取了63%的剩余。参与者在规则选择适应估值分布的程度方面存在异质性，其中大部分剩余损失由一小部分参与者造成。

title: Democracy and pro-market sentiments
title_zh: 民主与亲市场情绪
title_primary: 民主与亲市场情绪
title_secondary: Democracy and pro-market sentiments
authors: Veeshan Rayamajhee
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study identifies 44 democratic transitions from 1980–2023 and estimates their effect on pro-market sentiments using a stacked difference-in-differences design. Democratic transitions reduce pro-market sentiments by 0.345 standard deviations on average. Yet the average masks a striking dynamic: a honeymoon spike more than four times the magnitude of the average decline, which reverses within two years. Cases of democratic deepening, where existing democracies further strengthened democratic governance, exhibit similar dynamics. The pattern survives a direct mean reversion test: countries with high and low baseline sentiments both exhibit the honeymoon spike. Falsification tests confirm the effect is specific to market attitudes, not a generic attitudinal shift. Declining beliefs in private ownership drive the negative medium-term effect even as acceptance of personal responsibility rises, suggesting ideological reconfiguration rather than uniform attitude decay. These findings indicate that the ideological foundations of market economies do not automatically consolidate alongside democratic institutions.
abstract_zh: 本研究识别了1980年至2023年间44次民主转型，并采用堆叠双重差分设计估计其对亲市场情绪的影响。民主转型平均使亲市场情绪下降0.345个标准差。然而，这一平均值掩盖了一个显著动态：蜜月期飙升幅度超过平均降幅的四倍，并在两年内逆转。在既有民主国家进一步加强民主治理的民主深化案例中，也呈现出类似动态。该模式通过了直接均值回归检验：基线情绪高和低的国家均表现出蜜月期飙升。证伪检验确认，该效应特定于市场态度，而非普遍的态度转变。对私有产权信念的下降驱动了负面的中期效应，即便个人责任接受度上升，这表明意识形态重构而非态度整体衰退。这些发现表明，市场经济的意识形态基础并不会随民主制度的确立而自动巩固。

title: Assessment and valuation of government policies to improve food animal welfare
title_zh: 改善食用动物福利的政府政策评估与价值分析
title_primary: 改善食用动物福利的政府政策评估与价值分析
title_secondary: Assessment and valuation of government policies to improve food animal welfare
authors: Richard Bennett, Kelvin Balcombe, Heather Maggs, Siobhan Abeyesinghe, Gareth Arnott 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: There is a need to assess the benefits of government policy to improve the welfare of food animals. We present a holistic, animal-centred welfare assessment method using an expert panel of independent animal welfare scientists linked to a survey of food shoppers’ willingness to pay (WTP) to improve welfare levels, using a 0–100 animal welfare scale. We apply this method to six food animal types in the UK and 15 different topical policy scenarios. We find that several current production systems have welfare scores below 50 but that some of the policy initiatives analysed could increase welfare scores substantially if implemented. We provide valuation tables of people’s WTP to increase welfare scores for each of the six animal types. Marginal WTP was found to diminish as welfare scores increased. WTP values are fully transferable across any policies affecting the animals involved and are not tied to specific production practices or contexts. The UK government has been using the method to evaluate a range of policy options to improve welfare. The method can be applied in other countries. The method enables government policy makers to better make the case for policies to improve the welfare of food animals and its application should lead to an increased likelihood of such policies being implemented. The outputs can also be used to inform consumers regarding the animal welfare provenance of the food they purchase. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 有必要评估政府政策在改善食用动物福利方面的效益。我们提出了一种整体性、以动物为中心的福利评估方法，该方法采用由独立动物福利科学家组成的专家小组，并结合对食品购物者支付意愿的调查，以0-100的动物福利量表衡量福利水平的改善。我们将此方法应用于英国的六类食用动物及15种不同的热点政策情景。研究发现，当前若干生产系统的福利评分低于50分，但若实施所分析的某些政策举措，福利评分可能大幅提升。我们提供了针对六类动物中每一类，人们为提升福利评分而愿意支付的估值表。研究发现，边际支付意愿随福利评分提高而递减。这些支付意愿值可完全转移至任何影响相关动物的政策，且不依赖于特定的生产实践或背景。英国政府已采用该方法评估一系列旨在改善福利的政策选项。该方法也可应用于其他国家。该方法使政府政策制定者能够更有力地论证改善食用动物福利政策的合理性，其应用应能提高此类政策得以实施的可能性。研究结果还可用于告知消费者其所购食品的动物福利来源。

title: The Cross‐Section of Household Preferences
title_zh: 家庭偏好的横截面分析
title_primary: 家庭偏好的横截面分析
title_secondary: The Cross‐Section of Household Preferences
authors: LAURENT E. CALVET, JOHN Y. CAMPBELL, FRANCISCO GOMES, PAOLO SODINI
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper estimates the cross‐sectional distribution of Epstein‐Zin preferences using the wealth and risky portfolio shares of a large panel of Swedish households. We find modestly heterogeneous risk aversion (standard deviation 0.97, median 7.50) and a meaningfully heterogeneous and right‐skewed time preference rate (TPR; standard deviation 7.31%, median 4.08%) and elasticity of intertemporal substitution (EIS; standard deviation 3.17, median 0.70). Risk aversion and the EIS are only very weakly negatively correlated. We estimate lower risk aversion for households with riskier labor income, and a higher TPR and lower EIS for households that enter our sample with low wealth.
abstract_zh: 本文利用瑞典家庭大样本的财富与风险资产组合份额，估计了Epstein-Zin偏好的横截面分布。研究发现：风险厌恶程度呈现适度异质性（标准差0.97，中位数7.50），而时间偏好率（TPR；标准差7.31%，中位数4.08%）与跨期替代弹性（EIS；标准差3.17，中位数0.70）则表现出显著的异质性与右偏分布特征。风险厌恶与EIS仅存在极弱的负相关关系。对于劳动收入风险较高的家庭，其风险厌恶程度较低；而初始财富水平较低的家庭则呈现更高的TPR与更低的EIS。

abstract: Using three independent archival sources, we previously documented substantial declines in stunting and wasting in Portugal during the mid-twentieth century. This note revisits the original evidence, clarifies the descriptive scope of our analysis, and situates the observed anthropometric changes within the broader evolution of public health, nutrition, and social policy in Portugal. We show that the timing and magnitude of the declines are robust to the alternative data restrictions and aggregation choices examined here, and that the documented improvements are consistent with contemporaneous expansions in health infrastructure and access documented in the historical record.
abstract_zh: 利用三个独立的档案来源，我们先前记录了二十世纪中叶葡萄牙发育迟缓与消瘦现象的显著下降。本注释重新审视原始证据，明确我们分析的描述性范围，并将观察到的体格测量变化置于葡萄牙公共卫生、营养及社会政策更广泛演变背景中。我们表明，这些下降的时间与幅度对于此处考察的替代数据限制和聚合选择具有稳健性，且记录到的改善与历史记载中同期卫生基础设施及可及性的扩展相一致。

title: Government reform and innovation performance in China
title_zh: 中国政府改革与创新绩效

authors: Min Zhang, Andrés Rodríguez-Pose
official: 官方在线 2024-10-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies the impact of government agency reforms, designed to enhance local government effectiveness, on the innovation performance of city-regions in China. We examine the adoption of these reforms between 2009 and 2016 as an exogenous shock to regional institutions. Our analysis identifies a positive and significant relationship between improvements in institutional quality and the innovation performance of Chinese city-regions, particularly pronounced in regions with medium to high levels of innovation. The results are robust to a series of checks including placebo and endogeneity tests and potential confounding policies. This research highlights the critical role of government institutions in driving innovation across China, bringing to the fore important regional variations in the adoption of government agency reforms that are defining the country’s innovation landscape.
abstract_zh: 本文研究旨在提升地方政府效能的政府机构改革对中国城市区域创新绩效的影响。我们将2009年至2016年间这些改革的实施视为区域制度的外生冲击。分析表明，制度质量提升与中国城市区域创新绩效之间存在显著正向关系，这一效应在中等至高创新水平的区域尤为突出。通过安慰剂检验、内生性检验及潜在混杂政策控制等一系列稳健性检验，该结果依然成立。本研究揭示了政府机构在驱动中国创新中的关键作用，并凸显了政府机构改革采纳过程中塑造国家创新格局的重要区域差异。

title: Distinguishing drought experiences: From perception to measurement and their significance on productivity value in Uganda
title_zh: 区分干旱经历：从感知到测量及其对乌干达生产力价值的意义

title_secondary: Distinguishing drought experiences: From perception to measurement and their significance on productivity value in Uganda
authors: Pakrooh, Parisa, Santeramo, Fabio, Maggio, Giuseppe, Santeramo, Fabio Gaetano
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Weather shocks increasingly threaten agricultural productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa. While the negative effects of drought on production have been documented in numerous studies, the behavioral dimension of adaptation, particularly how households perceive drought and what shapes these perceptions, remains less explored. The study focuses on Uganda to distinguish between self-reported drought (subjective) and data-driven drought (objective) and how their divergence is associated with agricultural outcomes. The study relies on four waves of household surveys (UNPS for 2009/10, 2010/11, 2011/12, and 2013/14) with historical re-analysis data on temperature and precipitation from 1981 to 2015. Log-linear and logit models are applied to estimate the association between drought, perception, and household characteristics on production and drought perception formation. Objective drought is negatively associated with total value of production. Subjective drought perception has a positive association with production. Self-reported drought captures differences in households’ behavioral responses or preparedness, rather than observed weather shocks. Households that underestimate drought conditions tend to exhibit lower production outcomes, while households reporting a drought when this is not observed in objective data tend to maintain their production levels. Access to the Drought Early Warning System (DEWS), technology adoption, higher education levels, farming experience, and greater off-farm assets are positively associated with higher production. Conversely, lower production is associated with a higher share of female labor, female-headed households, and poverty. The results highlight the importance of distinguishing between perceived and observed drought and improving households’ access to timely information to plan adaptation strategies.
abstract_zh: 天气冲击日益威胁撒哈拉以南非洲的农业生产。尽管大量研究已证实干旱对生产的负面影响，但适应行为维度——尤其是家庭如何感知干旱以及影响这些感知的因素——仍鲜有探讨。本研究聚焦乌干达，区分自我报告的干旱（主观）与数据驱动的干旱（客观），并分析两者差异与农业产出的关联。研究采用四轮家庭调查数据（乌干达国家面板调查2009/10、2010/11、2011/12和2013/14年度）及1981至2015年历史再分析气温与降水数据，运用对数线性模型和逻辑模型估计干旱、感知及家庭特征对生产和干旱感知形成的影响。客观干旱与生产总价值呈负相关，而主观干旱感知与生产呈正相关。自我报告的干旱反映的是家庭行为响应或准备程度的差异，而非实际观测到的天气冲击。低估干旱条件的家庭往往产出较低，而在客观数据未显示干旱时报告干旱的家庭则能维持生产水平。获取干旱早期预警系统、采用技术、较高教育水平、务农经验及更多非农资产与更高产出正相关；反之，女性劳动力占比高、女性户主家庭及贫困则与较低产出相关。研究结果凸显区分感知干旱与观测干旱的重要性，并强调需改善家庭获取及时信息的渠道以规划适应策略。

abstract: We consider a common correlated effects estimator for panel quantile regression models featuring heterogeneous slope coefficients and interactive fixed effects. Using convolution smoothing to facilitate the derivation of asymptotic properties, our method allows the number of time periods (T) to grow at a much slower rate than the number of cross-sectional units (N). We establish that the mean group estimator converges to a limiting normal distribution, which may have a nonzero mean in our asymptotic framework. To address biases from the smoothed objective function and a relatively small T, we introduce a two-step bias correction procedure. Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate the method’s validity in finite samples, and we apply it to analyze the sharp rise in demand for high-skilled workers in U.S. manufacturing.

title: Unity through rivalry: How competition mitigates social dilemmas
title_zh: 竞争中的团结：竞争如何缓解社会困境
title_primary: 竞争中的团结：竞争如何缓解社会困境

source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-30 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study whether competition between groups that yields no material rewards fosters within-group cooperation. In a laboratory experiment, pairs of subjects played an indefinitely repeated Prisoner’s Dilemma either in isolation or in a tournament against another pair, where winning conferred no monetary payoff. The competitive environment increased cooperation, and the effect strengthened over time as subjects gained experience. Exploiting the binary action space of the repeated game, we estimate participants’ strategies and find that the tournament reallocates play away from strategies that start with defection toward strategies that start with cooperation. This reallocation results in a shift from Always Defect to the least risky cooperative strategy, Grim. We complement the experiment with a simple tournament-based model that shows how non-monetary competition can shift equilibrium selection toward cooperative strategies.
abstract_zh: 我们研究的是，不产生物质回报的群体间竞争是否能够促进群体内部的合作。在一项实验室实验中，成对的参与者要么在隔离环境中，要么在与另一对进行锦标赛式对抗中，参与无限重复的囚徒困境游戏，其中获胜并不带来金钱收益。竞争环境增强了合作，且随着参与者积累经验，这一效应随时间增强。利用重复博弈的二元行动空间，我们估计了参与者的策略，并发现锦标赛将游戏行为从以背叛开始的策略重新分配至以合作开始的策略。这种重新分配导致从“始终背叛”转向风险最低的合作策略——“冷酷策略”。我们通过一个简单的基于锦标赛的模型补充实验，该模型展示了非金钱竞争如何将均衡选择转向合作策略。

title: The Changing Global Division of Labor in Software: Emergence and Diffusion of New Programming Skills across IT Hubs
title_zh: 软件领域全球劳动分工的变迁：新兴编程技能在IT枢纽中的涌现与扩散
title_primary: 软件领域全球劳动分工的变迁：新兴编程技能在IT枢纽中的涌现与扩散

authors: Johannes Wachs, Xiangnan Feng, Simone Daniotti, Frank Neffke
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: With the rise of new industries, often new jobs emerge. Evolutionary Economic Geography and in particular Industry Life Cycle perspectives predict that these activities first emerge in a limited number of cities to then diffuse to other locations as job descriptions become more standardized. Here, we focus on a particularly important new industry: software development, an activity that is economically important, quickly changing, and has a pronounced spatial concentration in a small number of global IT hubs. We use an online database of over 60 million questions and answers about problems in software development that yields a longitudinal dataset of 237 software skills. By geo-locating 3 million posting users at regular intervals, we link these skills to cities worldwide. We find that, in spite of its digital nature, the software industry exhibits similar spatial regularities as previously observed in more traditional sectors. First, cities diversify into skills that are related to their existing ones. Second, new skills first emerge in cities with large and diversified software sectors, and later diffuse -- mostly unhindered by geographical distance -- to smaller cities specialized in closely related skills. We find suggestive but limited support for a windows of locational opportunity account: although even brand-new skills still emerge first in cities with strong prior specialization in related skills, concentrations of related activities impact less the emergence of new skills than the diffusion of existing ones.
abstract_zh: 随着新兴产业的崛起，新职业往往随之涌现。演化经济地理学，特别是产业生命周期理论预测，这些活动最初会在少数城市出现，随后随着职位描述日趋标准化而扩散至其他地区。本文聚焦于一个尤为重要的新兴产业——软件开发：这一经济活动具有重要经济价值、快速迭代特征，且高度集中于少数全球IT枢纽城市。我们利用一个包含超过6000万条软件开发问题与答案的在线数据库，构建了涵盖237项软件技能的纵向数据集。通过对300万用户进行定期地理定位，我们将这些技能与全球城市相关联。研究发现，尽管软件开发具有数字属性，但其空间分布规律与传统行业高度相似：首先，城市会向与其现有技能相关的领域进行多元化拓展；其次，新技能最初出现在软件产业规模庞大且多元化的城市，随后——基本不受地理距离阻碍——向专精于相近技能的小城市扩散。我们发现了支持"区位机会窗口"理论的初步证据，但该理论解释力有限：尽管全新技能仍优先出现在相关技能基础雄厚的城市，但相关活动的集聚程度对新技能涌现的影响，要弱于对现有技能扩散的影响。

abstract: This paper examines the causal impact of cannabidiol (CBD) product availability on workplace injuries, exploiting Italy’s unintended liberalization of low-THC cannabis as a natural experiment. We use a staggered difference-in-differences approach, leveraging variation in the timing of CBD retailer entries across provinces. We find that CBD availability leads to a reduction in workplace injury rates by 2.5%, with larger effects among young and prime-age workers. Robustness checks confirm these findings, and placebo tests rule out confounding trends. These effects are stronger in provinces with higher pre-existing use of pharmaceuticals commonly prescribed for stress, anxiety, sleep disorders, and chronic therapies. We interpret this pattern as suggestive of a substitution-based channel in which CBD products may represent an additional source of pain and stress management.
abstract_zh: 本文利用意大利低THC大麻意外合法化作为自然实验，考察大麻二酚（CBD）产品可及性对工伤的因果影响。我们采用交错双重差分法，利用各省CBD零售商进入时间的差异。研究发现，CBD可及性使工伤率降低2.5%，其中对青年和壮年劳动者的影响更为显著。稳健性检验证实了上述结论，安慰剂检验排除了混杂趋势的影响。在那些此前常用于缓解压力、焦虑、睡眠障碍及慢性治疗的药物使用率较高的省份，这种效应更为突出。我们将这一模式解读为替代效应渠道的佐证，即CBD产品可能成为疼痛与压力管理的额外来源。

title: On the right track? Railroads, industrial development, and distributional effects in historical China
title_zh: 正轨之上？历史中国的铁路、工业发展与分配效应
title_primary: 正轨之上？历史中国的铁路、工业发展与分配效应
title_secondary: On the right track? Railroads, industrial development, and distributional effects in historical China
authors: Shiyu Bo, Ting Chen, Cong Liu, Yan Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-02 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We present the first quantitative evaluation of the overall impact and distributional effects of railroad access on industrial growth in historical China. Using newly digitized data on railroad expansion and distance to hypothetical railroad networks as instruments, we find that railroad access significantly increased the annual entry of local industrial firms from 1858 to 1936 and industrial output in 1933. However, the effect is highly localized, concentrated in counties within 10 km of railroad lines, and stronger in historical population and transportation centers. Using a causal mediation framework to analyze the textile industry, we find that railroads facilitated firm entry primarily by enhancing market access to manufactured yarn and lowering travel costs for workers and technicians. Further evidence shows that access to railroads promoted technology adoption.
abstract_zh: 我们首次对历史中国铁路通达对工业增长的整体影响及其分配效应进行了定量评估。利用新数字化的铁路扩张数据及至假设铁路网络的距离作为工具变量，我们发现铁路通达显著增加了1858年至1936年间地方工业企业的新增进入数量，并提升了1933年的工业产出。然而，这一效应高度局部化，集中于铁路线10公里范围内的县，且在历史人口与交通中心更为显著。通过运用因果中介框架分析纺织业，我们发现铁路主要通过增强对机制纱的市场准入及降低工人和技术人员的旅行成本来促进企业进入。进一步证据表明，铁路通达还促进了技术采纳。

title: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
title_zh: 信息偏好、参照点与享乐编辑：实验证据
title_primary: 信息偏好、参照点与享乐编辑：实验证据
title_secondary: Information preferences, reference points and hedonic editing: experimental evidence
authors: Noemi Peter, Mark van Oldeniel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We experimentally investigate preferences for clumping-versus-separating information in the gain and the loss domains, and also preferences for timing. Our design is motivated by the idea that information preferences may depend on reference points. Subjects participate in two monetary lotteries and choose how to receive the outcome information. For half of the subjects, the lotteries are framed as two gain lotteries; for the other half, as two loss lotteries. Based on Thaler (1985) one can expect that people want to learn the outcomes of the gain lotteries separately and the outcomes of the loss lotteries clumped together (cf. hedonic editing hypothesis). On the other hand, a different reference dependent model by Koszegi and Rabin (2009) relies on expectations-based reference points, and predicts that subjects should prefer clumped information irrespective of the frame. The results of our experiment show a preference for separating information about gains, and no preference for clumping or separating information about losses. Regarding timing, we find a weak overall preference for receiving information sooner. These findings provide new insights into information preferences. We conclude by discussing policy implications, as well as our additional contributions to related literature.
abstract_zh: 我们通过实验研究了人们在收益域和损失域中对信息聚合与分离的偏好，以及对信息获取时机的偏好。实验设计基于信息偏好可能依赖于参照点的理论假设。受试者参与两项货币抽奖，并选择如何接收结果信息。其中一半受试者的抽奖被设定为两项收益抽奖，另一半则为两项损失抽奖。根据Thaler（1985）的理论，人们可能倾向于分别了解收益抽奖的结果，而将损失抽奖的结果合并了解（参见享乐编辑假说）。另一方面，Koszegi和Rabin（2009）提出的基于期望参照点的不同参照依赖模型则预测，无论抽奖框架如何，受试者都应偏好信息聚合。实验结果显示，受试者偏好将收益信息分离呈现，而对损失信息则未表现出聚合或分离的明确偏好。在时机方面，我们发现受试者整体上微弱偏好尽早获取信息。这些发现为信息偏好研究提供了新见解。最后，我们讨论了政策含义及对相关文献的额外贡献。

title: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
title_zh: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品信息披露标准的透明度与市场影响
title_primary: 观点：评估美国国家生物工程食品信息披露标准的透明度与市场影响
title_secondary: Viewpoint: evaluating transparency and market consequences of the national bioengineered food disclosure standard in the United States
authors: Pei Zhou, Yuqing Zheng, Shuoli Zhao, Jane Kolodinsky, Tyler Mark 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-15 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The 2018 National Bioengineered Food Disclosure Standard (NBFDS) mandated disclosure of bioengineered (BE) ingredients in regulated foods in the United States, with full compliance required by January 2022. The policy is intended to reduce information asymmetry by enabling consumers to infer BE status through mandatory labeling, alongside existing voluntary claims such as organic and non-GMO labels. This viewpoint paper concludes that the current design and implementation of the NBFDS do not fully support this transparency objective in practice. We show that several regulatory features weaken the inference mechanism linking disclosure to consumer understanding on which the policy relies, including evolving definition and terminology associated with BE foods, electronic and digital disclosure options, detectability-based exclusions for highly refined products, exemptions from mandatory disclosure, and limited ingredient specificity. As a result, under the current design, mandatory BE labeling increases consumer search costs and cognitive burden while creating implementation challenges for industry. These findings underscore the importance of careful policy design in achieving effective transparency. Continued evaluation and evidence-based refinement are needed to improve the effectiveness of the law.
abstract_zh: 2018年美国《国家生物工程食品披露标准》（NBFDS）规定，受监管食品必须披露生物工程（BE）成分，全面合规要求于2022年1月前完成。该政策旨在通过强制性标签，使消费者能够推断BE状态，同时结合现有的自愿性标签（如有机和非转基因标签），以减少信息不对称。本文观点认为，NBFDS当前的设计与实施在实践中并未完全支持这一透明度目标。我们指出，若干监管特征削弱了政策所依赖的、将披露与消费者理解相联系的推断机制，包括BE食品相关定义和术语的不断演变、电子和数字披露选项、针对高度精炼产品的可检测性排除、强制性披露的豁免，以及有限的成分特异性。因此，在当前设计下，强制性BE标签增加了消费者的搜索成本和认知负担，同时给行业带来了实施挑战。这些发现强调了审慎政策设计在实现有效透明度方面的重要性。持续评估和基于证据的改进对于提升该法律的有效性不可或缺。

title: Benefitting from brutality? Profits of north‐western Europe's slave trade at the eve of the industrial revolution
title_zh: 从残暴中获益？工业革命前夕西北欧奴隶贸易的利润
title_primary: 从残暴中获益？工业革命前夕西北欧奴隶贸易的利润
title_secondary: Benefitting from brutality? Profits of north‐western Europe's slave trade at the eve of the industrial revolution
authors: Klas Rönnbäck, Guillaume Daudin, Gerhard de Kok, David Richardson, Miguel Geraldes Rodrigues
official: 官方在线 2026-04-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract One of the most contentious issues in the study of the Atlantic slave trade is the profitability of the trade. In this paper, we contribute by pooling all available data on transatlantic slave ship voyage accounts into a joint dataset. This dataset includes data from a period of 100 years (1730–1830) and from five nations (Denmark, France, Great Britain, the Netherlands, and Spain). It permits calculation of the trade's profitability (total net returns over net outlays). Using weight calibration sampling methods, we compute a representative profit rate between 1750 and 1795 for France, Great Britain, and the Netherlands. Our results suggest that the average profitability (net returns over net outlay) was not remarkably high (around 11–14 per cent for multi‐year ventures), with a very high variance. Some observations allow the computation of internal rates of return, which we then apply to the rest of the dataset. This shows that profits were low compared with alternative investment opportunities.
abstract_zh: 摘要 在大西洋奴隶贸易研究中，最具争议的问题之一是该贸易的盈利能力。本文通过将所有可获得的跨大西洋奴隶船航程账户数据整合为一个联合数据集来作出贡献。该数据集涵盖了100年（1730年至1830年）的时间跨度，并涉及五个国家（丹麦、法国、英国、荷兰和西班牙）。它使得计算该贸易的盈利能力（总净收益相对于净支出）成为可能。利用权重校准抽样方法，我们计算了1750年至1795年间法国、英国和荷兰的代表性利润率。我们的结果表明，平均盈利能力（净收益相对于净支出）并不显著高（多年期企业约为11%至14%），且方差极大。部分观测数据允许计算内部收益率，我们随后将其应用于数据集的其余部分。这表明，与替代投资机会相比，利润较低。

title: Misalignment in Carbon Credit Programmes: Insights From Producer Preferences for Cover Crop and No‐Till Contracts
title_zh: 碳信用项目中的错位：来自生产者对覆盖作物与免耕合同偏好的启示
title_primary: 碳信用项目中的错位：来自生产者对覆盖作物与免耕合同偏好的启示
title_secondary: Misalignment in Carbon Credit Programmes: Insights From Producer Preferences for Cover Crop and No‐Till Contracts
authors: Grant Edward Gardner, Gabriel S. Sampson, Shuoli Zhao
source: Australian Journal of Agricultural and Resource Economics
official: 官方在线 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines the factors influencing producer adoption of cover cropping and no‐till farming, two key carbon sequestration practices, within the context of voluntary carbon credit programmes (CCPs) in Kansas. Using a mixed‐methods survey that combines discrete choice experiments with farm‐level data from 370 producers, we estimate random‐parameter latent class models to assess preferences over contract design, payment levels and agri‐environmental constraints. Findings reveal substantial misalignments between current CCP structures and producer needs: nearly half of respondents consistently rejected all contract offers, while those most willing to enrol were often already using the promoted practices, raising concerns about the additionality of these initiatives. Key barriers include long contract durations, insufficient payments and agri‐environmental limitations such as drought and wheat‐based rotations. These results highlight the need for more flexible, regionally tailored carbon programmes and provide actionable insights for policymakers seeking to enhance the adoption and climate impact of agricultural carbon sequestration initiatives.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了在堪萨斯州自愿碳信用计划（CCPs）背景下，影响生产者采纳覆盖作物种植和免耕耕作这两种关键碳封存实践的因素。通过结合离散选择实验与来自370位生产者的农场层面数据的混合方法调查，我们估计了随机参数潜在类别模型，以评估对合同设计、支付水平及农业环境约束的偏好。研究发现，当前CCP结构与生产者需求之间存在显著错位：近半数受访者一贯拒绝所有合同提议，而最愿意参与的生产者往往已在采用所推广的实践，这引发了对这些项目额外性的担忧。主要障碍包括合同期限过长、支付不足以及干旱和以小麦为基础的轮作等农业环境限制。这些结果凸显了对更灵活、区域定制化碳项目的需求，并为政策制定者提供了可操作的见解，以促进农业碳封存倡议的采纳及其气候影响。

title: Interregional spillovers and optimal budget institutions under asymmetric information
title_zh: 信息不对称下的区域间溢出效应与最优预算制度
title_primary: 信息不对称下的区域间溢出效应与最优预算制度
title_secondary: Interregional spillovers and optimal budget institutions under asymmetric information
authors: Darong Dai, Haoyang Li, Guoqiang Tian
official: 官方在线 2025-08-06 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We analyze optimal budget institutions for local governments in a scenario where local public goods generate positive interregional externalities, such as environmental protection. There is a central government (referred to as the center) and two regions. Each region possesses private information regarding the extent of beneficial spillovers it experiences from the public goods provided by the other region. To achieve constrained efficiency, it is necessary to address these externalities while also tackling the center’s self-selection issue in the presence of asymmetric information. One way to implement the optimal solution under asymmetric information is through a simultaneous-move equilibrium. The center can set a minimum debt level for the region that generates higher spillovers and impose a Pigouvian tax on the region benefiting more from spillovers, subsequently transferring the revenue as a subsidy to the other region. Alternatively, a sequential-move equilibrium can implement the asymmetric information optimum with the additional condition that the follower region’s optimal debt choice is concave in the leader region’s debt choice.
abstract_zh: 我们分析地方政府在地方公共品产生正向跨区域外部性（如环境保护）情境下的最优预算制度。存在一个中央政府（简称中心）和两个地区。每个地区对于从另一地区提供的公共品中获得的有利溢出程度拥有私人信息。为实现受限效率，必须解决这些外部性，同时应对信息不对称条件下中心的自选择问题。在信息不对称下实施最优解的一种方式是通过同时行动均衡。中心可以为产生较高溢出效应的地区设定最低债务水平，并对从溢出中受益更多的地区征收庇古税，随后将税收收入作为补贴转移给另一地区。或者，顺序行动均衡可以在附加条件下实施信息不对称最优解，即跟随地区的最优债务选择是领导地区债务选择的凹函数。
